description: Implementation of the ConfiguredProxyResolutionService class and related proxy resolver factory classes, managing proxy configuration, PAC script fetching, and periodic polling for proxy changes in Chromium.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService::InitProxyResolver
classes.description: Handles asynchronous initialization of proxy resolver, including PAC file decision and resolver creation.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService::PacFileDeciderPoller
classes.description: Encapsulates periodic polling logic to detect changes in PAC scripts or proxy configurations.

classes.name: ConfiguredProxyResolutionService
classes.description: Manages proxy configuration, PAC script fetching, resolver creation, and request handling.

classes.name: DefaultPollPolicy
classes.description: Defines the default policy for polling PAC scripts based on success or failure.

methods.name: CreateUsingSystemProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates a proxy resolution service using the system's proxy resolver if supported.

methods.name: CreateWithoutProxyResolver
methods.description: Creates a proxy resolution service without a system proxy resolver.

methods.name: CreateFixedForTest
methods.description: Creates a fixed proxy configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Resolves the proxy for a given URL, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles network IP address changes, delaying PAC re-evaluation.

methods.name: OnDNSChanged
methods.description: Handles DNS changes, triggering PAC script lazy polling.
